comment: Licence policy for scripts/publish_artifacts.py. Each rule says which corpora an artifact derives from and whether its payload holds corpus text (passages, chunks, transcripts, or model text written from them). The first rule that matches wins, and an artifact no rule matches is refused. Text under a CC BY-NC or CC BY-SA licence is refused unless an allowlist entry matches it and gives a reason. FinanceBench (CC BY-NC) has no allowlist entry. ServerFault (CC BY-SA) has entries, and a release holding its text carries a per-post attribution file. Corpora the package pins take their licence from aieng.advanced_rag.corpora; the licences below cover the rest.
